channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Virtus Bologna | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Virtus Bologna from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sergio Scariolo on Virtus Bologna
item.description:
“I cannot comment on a process that is still ongoing. I can and want to express all my gratitude towards Virtus and Toronto for the understanding and flexibility shown in considering the mutual reasons that emerged in this week of contacts”

Sergio Scariolo on Virtus Bologna, Jun 8, 2023. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Sergio Scariolo on Virtus Bologna
item.description:
However,the coach clearly stated that his contract with Virtus allows him to coach Spain and he will be continuing on both benches.

“I don’t know where certain gossip comes from, and I don’t usually comment on gossip but anyway, and even for once, it’s worth clarifying that: My contract with Virtus explicitly provides in writing that I can participate in the windows of the national team. And my contract with the Spanish Basketball Federation does not foresee any type of exit and that contract extends until the end of the 2024 Olympic Games,”

Sergio Scariolo on Virtus Bologna, May 17, 2022. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Petteri Koponen on Virtus Bologna
item.description:
“To stay with Virtus? Why not? My goal is to play in Euroleague because I think for me it is important to play at the highest European level. And if I can play in Euroleague with Virtus Bologna, anyone would be happier than me. I don't know what is going to happen from now to June. NBA or Euroleague? It is not clear to me as well. If Virtus Bologna plays in Euroleague, I know I would have an important role in the team. Dallas Mavericks? I spoke with them a couple of time, they told me to finish the season with Virtus”

Petteri Koponen on Virtus Bologna, Jan 18, 2012. Source: Sportando.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Virtus Bologna
item.description:
Manu Ginobili:

“When the Pre Olympic was over I was excited [about playing in Italy]. I wanted to. But soon after I thought about it more: I have a family, and to do such a thing and then have to come back [to the NBA] when the lockout is over... It's not what I like to do. I don't rule it out. We don't know when it's going to end. As I've always said, Bologna is a place where I have great memories and I would like to go back there.”

Manu Ginobili on Virtus Bologna, Oct 13, 2011. Source: Basquet Plus.

item.title: Claudio Sabatini on Kobe Bryant, Virtus Bologna
item.description:
Claudio Sabatini released another interview at SkySport24 about his project to sign Kobe Bryant during the NBA lockout.

“We have been working also last night with his agent. There is still a money difference between our proposal and his request. But we are ready to go towards his requirements. I want to thank Kobe for his words for us and Italy, he showed that he is a champion in and off the court. We raised our proposal for him but we want him in Italy, not just in Bologna, because he would be a huge addition to the whole country. Kobe Bryant would re-launch the Italian basketball. Serie A will start on October 9th, we hope that the final answer is close”

Claudio Sabatini on Kobe Bryant, Virtus Bologna, Sep 29, 2011. Source: Sportando.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Virtus Bologna
item.description:
In an exclusive interview released at DiarioShow.com,Manu Ginobili confirmed that Virtus Bologna is the only option if he decides to play overseas during the NBA Lockout.

“I did not say NO to the proposal. In Bologna I had great time and my wife Marianela loves Italy. There is a possibility that I will join Virtus Bologna during the NBA lockout. I have to give an answer by the end of the month. I had also an offer from Brazil but if I leave San Antonio Spurs during the lockout, I am going to play only with Virtus Bologna. It would be just for few months and then I will be back to Spurs”

Manu Ginobili on Virtus Bologna, Sep 26, 2011. Source: Sportando.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Virtus Bologna
item.description:
Manu Ginobili:

“(Virtus Bologna) called my agent and told him they wanted me on board. A lot of things came to my mind and for a second thought about it because of all the things I went through there, but I will evaluate (the option) going forward.”

Manu Ginobili on Virtus Bologna, Sep 15, 2011. Source: Cancha Llena.

item.title: Claudio Sabatini on Carlos Delfino, Virtus Bologna
item.description:
Claudio Sabatini, owner of Virtus Bologna, confirmed today that Carlos Delfino was offered to the team with an NBA out.

“Carlos Delfino was offered to Virtus Bologna with an NBA out. We were interested in him and we made an offer but we could not find an agreement”

Claudio Sabatini on Carlos Delfino, Virtus Bologna, Sep 5, 2011. Source: Sportando.
